name: CodeGuard AI
tagline: Self-hosted, customizable AI code review for GitHub Pull Requests, with configurable model providers and a source-code workflow developers can extend.
pricing: $15 one-time for the commercial source-code package; AI provider and hosting costs are separate.
selfHostedNote: The commercial package is designed to run in the buyer's own environment; this is source code, not a hosted SaaS service.
modelControl: Supports OpenAI, Google Gemini, Groq, and Ollama; provider configuration and available options should be verified against the supplied commercial package.

01-multi-dimensional-context.note: Repository-aware review and behavior-impact analysis are described for the product; cross-repository dependency analysis is not documented in the public showcase.

02-rule-centric.note: Configurable team rules and review instructions are included; a default-quiet, version-controlled rules-as-code workflow is not publicly documented.

03-dual-workflow.note: The public materials document GitHub Pull Request reviews, webhooks, and manual reviews; local IDE or pre-commit review mode is not documented.

04-business-logic.note: Behavior-impact analysis is described, but ticket or issue-tracker acceptance-criteria validation is not documented.

05-continuous-learning.note: Reviewer feedback learning is described for the product; learning from approval/rejection history and regression prevention are not independently documented in the public showcase.

06-sandbox-validation.note: Suggested patches have a validation layer and Apply Fix safeguards are described; isolated sandbox execution of generated patches is not documented.

07-economic-transparency.note: The source-code package is a one-time purchase and supports configurable model providers, including Ollama; separate provider and hosting costs may apply.

08-actionability.note: AI-suggested patches and a guarded GitHub Apply Fix workflow are described; automatic test execution and a completed end-to-end validation loop are not claimed.

09-measurable-roi.note: Review history, trend tracking, and quality/risk information are described; DORA metrics and quantified ROI reporting are not documented.
